urdu.name: شہر العزۃ
urdu.long_meaning: Shahrul (شہر العزۃ) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم شہر العزۃ، عزت کا مہینہ ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

faq.question: What does Shahrul mean?
faq.answer: Shahrul is associated with the Arabic form شَهْرُ الْعِزَّة, whose core sense is shahrul; month of honour (malay form).

faq.question: What is the origin of Shahrul?
faq.answer: Shahrul is associated with Arabic. Shahrul is the Malay form of Arabic شَهْرُ الْعِزَّة (Shahr al-ʿIzza), meaning 'month of honour'.

faq.question: Is Shahrul an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form شَهْرُ الْعِزَّة is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Shahrul an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Shahrul can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Shahrul a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Shahrul should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Shahr al-ʿIzza is a compound of Arabic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.question: What does Shahrul mean in Persian?

faq.question: What are the variants of Shahrul?
faq.answer: Romanization variants include Shahrul, shahrul. Script forms are شهر العزه, شهرالعزه, شَهْرُ الْعِزَّة, شہر العزۃ, शहरुल.
